package.name: wake_mod
package.description: dorai wake-word gate. Builds a SECOND Vosk KaldiRecognizer over the same 16 kHz model stt_mod already loads, constrained to a one-word grammar (keyword plus an explicit [unk] garbage token), and publishes /dorai/wake as the DEMO_INTERFACES JSON. Owns the bearing pairing: it keeps a ring of recent /dorai/doa messages and attaches the one whose stamp is nearest the wake word's own audio window, so the bridge and the behaviour node stay dumb. Adds no dependency.
